## Change

Describe the concrete behavior, failure or documentation change and why it is needed.

## Evidence

- Tests run:
- Tests not run and why:
- Browser/site scope:
- Privacy, accessibility and numerical-uncertainty impact:
- Schema or migration impact:
- Dependency, license, notice or SBOM impact:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Fixtures and examples are synthetic and redistributable.
- [ ] This change contains no credentials, signed URLs, raw IPs, private hostnames, employee content, real prompts or answers, authenticated HAR files, browser profiles, production data or real documents.
- [ ] Missing measurements remain unknown; no estimate is described as a provider measurement.
- [ ] Historical schemas, methods and observations are preserved or changed through an explicit version/migration.
- [ ] Relevant tests, browser targets and failure states were checked, or the unrun scope is stated above.
- [ ] Added or changed third-party code, data and assets have exact provenance, license and notice updates.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line from the contributor.
